title: A Cart with a Name
request: Bring a catalog containing only title and pages, in that column order. Keep the books in their original order.
objective: Select named columns and keep the new table returned by an operation.
hints: The patron wants a table with two named columns, not one loose tray.
select returns a new table; it does not trim the original cart.
Assign shelf.select(...) to a name, listing the two requested labels in order, then deliver that name.
inputCode:
import random
from datascience import Table, make_array
n = random.randint(2, 7)
titles = make_array(*[random.choice(['Moss Almanac', 'Cloud Atlas', 'Fern Letters', 'Rain Ledger']) + ' ' + str(i + 1) for i in range(n)])
pages = make_array(*[random.randint(24, 340) for _ in range(n)])
authors = make_array(*[random.choice(['Ada Reed', 'Orin Bell', 'Lena Moss']) for _ in range(n)])
shelf = Table().with_columns('title', titles, 'pages', pages, 'author', authors)
